items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: every record that I made with Clarence Williams, Cy St. Clair was on it because he was the one that got me the job.

ctx.x: PS: Now July 8th, 1927 for Vocalion he records a tune called "Aunt Jemima" with supposedly Red Allen present, but the music was not issued. You -

Wait a second, let me give you the names of some, then you compare it with that book. Here's the, here's some of the names I remember real well. The first session we had Cy St. La, Cy St. Clair on bass. And if Cy St. Clair isn't on those records then I wasn't there, because every record that I made with Clarence Williams, Cy St. Clair was on it because he was the one that got me the job.
